title: Calculus of local Hölder classes C^{l,α}_loc(Ω): constants, sums, bilinear products, smooth compositions, inclusion and the derivative characterization
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, 0 < α ≤ 1, Ω ⊆ ℝ^m open, l ∈ ℕ. For a normed space E and f : ℝ^m → E say f ∈ H_l (= C^{l,α}_loc(Ω)) if f is C^l on Ω and every x ∈ Ω has ρ > 0 with B_ρ(x) ⊆ Ω and C with ‖D^l f(y) − D^l f(z)‖ ≤ C‖y − z‖^α for y, z ∈ B_ρ(x) (D^l f = iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f). Then, for all real normed spaces E, E₁, E₂, E₃: (1) constant maps are in H_l; (2) f, g ∈ H_l ⇒ f + g ∈ H_l; (3) if β : E₁ × E₂ → E₃ is continuous bilinear and f₁, f₂ ∈ H_l then x ↦ β(f₁(x), f₂(x)) ∈ H_l; (4) if Φ : E₁ → E₂ is C^∞ and f ∈ H_l then Φ∘f ∈ H_l; (5) if f is C^{l+1} on Ω then f ∈ H_l; (6) if f is C¹ on Ω then f ∈ H_{l+1} ⇔ (x ↦ Df(x)) ∈ H_l.
